task: Bug: `tenacity.after_log` crashes with `TypeError` when `retry_state.seconds_since_start` is `None` (it is `None` when the outcome timestamp has not been set). The log message should still be emitted, showing "?" in place of the elapsed seconds.
why: The source changes are byte-identical (same blob hash `7732146`). Both print "?" when `seconds_since_start` is `None`, both still emit the log message, and both pass the gates. The two tests are also the same apart from the test name and docstring. I picked c2 on maintainability: its name `..._unset` and its docstring ("outcome timestamp has not been set") describe the cause given in the task. c1 lost only because its name and docstring just repeat the `None` symptom; nothing in its code is wrong.
